structured_output.what_is_happening: A token called "Binance Accelerationism" (b/acc) was created directly as a PumpSwap pool about 11 minutes before detection. It did not migrate from the pump.fun bonding curve (migrated_unix=0, launchpad null). It went up about 700% to roughly $96k market cap, with $175k volume and 2,300+ buys against about 260 sells. The project description is a BSC contract address ending in 7777, and the X handle is simply "binance". That suggests a Solana copy of a BSC/Binance-themed b/acc token. An identically named token created about 3 minutes earlier now shows $0.01 liquidity, so it is effectively dead or rugged. One unlabeled wallet holds 80.57% of supply, separate from the AMM pool's 15.93%. The LP is 100% unlocked and the creator account is closed.

narrative.description: b/acc ('Binance accelerationism') is a Binance/CZ-adjacent meme with a real audience in BSC circles. Here it is a cross-chain copy that points to a BSC contract address and uses the generic 'binance' handle. It has no website, no socials and no DexScreener profile.
narrative.why_spreading: The buying pattern (2,047 unique buyers vs 36 sellers in about 15 minutes, 83% bot/degen share) looks like bot or sniper-swarm flow reacting to a trending BSC ticker, not organic Solana community spread.

token_connection.why_this_token: It is the second same-name Solana deployment within minutes. It carries only a pasted BSC contract address and has no official link to the BSC original or to Binance.
token_connection.competing_tokens: 3CTtZ9CD… (same name and ticker, created about 3 minutes earlier, liquidity already $0.01, so apparently rugged). The BSC original (0xcf57…7777) is the canonical token.

authenticity.evidence: The buy/sell ratio is about 9:1, with 2,047 unique buyers but only 36 sellers. That is extreme and consistent with many small bot buys. The bot/degen rate is 0.83 and there are 10 bundler wallets. One wallet holds 80.57% of supply outside the pool. The earlier same-name copy has already been drained.
authenticity.uncertainty: The 80.57% wallet could be an unlabeled locker or burn address, but nothing in the packet says so. No X data is available.

structural_risks: One unlabeled wallet holds 80.57% of supply. The pool holds only about 16%, so that wallet can drain the roughly $15k SOL side by selling.
LP 100% unlocked (lp_burn_ratio 0), so it can be pulled at any moment
Direct PumpSwap pool rather than a pump.fun curve graduate. The deployer controls both the LP and the supply.
Creator account closed, which hides who owns the supply
An identical copy already rugged minutes earlier, suggesting a serial-deploy pattern

structured_output.counterargument: Binance/CZ memes can draw heavy Solana attention very fast, and 2,000+ unique buyers in 15 minutes is real breadth even if much of it is bots. If the 80% wallet is actually a locker or unlabeled burn address, the pool could keep absorbing momentum buyers. A move from $96k to $200k in 6 hours would then be plausible, and the dead earlier copy leaves this one as the only live Solana b/acc token.
unknowns: Who owns the 80.57% wallet (deployer, locker or burn address)
Whether the BSC b/acc token is trending right now
Whether the buyer count is inflated by bot micro-buys

source_coverage.notes: No internet access in this condition. The report relies only on the evidence packet.

structured_output.thesis: This is a serial-copy Binance-meme deployment. The supply is 80% concentrated in one non-pool wallet, the LP is unlocked and the creator account is closed. An identical token from minutes earlier is already drained. The buying looks like a bot swarm. The most likely outcome is a liquidity pull or a dump of the 80% bag into a thin pool well before any 2x from entry.
